description: GCSE Science Booster - Mobile revision app for GCSE Biology, Chemistry and Physics with flashcards, quizzes, mock exams, progress tracking and grade prediction.
面向计算机专业自学者与 408 考研的 AI 学习助手。用结构化学生画像驱动 9 个专职教学   Agent，完成讲解、思维导图、出题、诊断与学习路径规划，跑通「讲解 → 练习 → 诊断 →   路径更新」闭环；内置知识库检索、三层幻觉校验与四科练习题库。Flask + SQLite + 原生前端，本地即可运行。

Medica Mentis is an educational platform for students in Nepal preparing for CEE and NEET. It offers easy-to-understand tutorials, practice MCQs, and downloadable notes for Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, and MAT, helping students learn, revise, and excel efficiently in entrance exams.

Chemist-tri was developed by Nur Syawani Hamdan, Tamilarasi A/P Arumugam and Rashidul Amin Saad to help students transition from traditional physical conduction to innovative online tasks. As a result, the student may acquire practical skills and information through a fully current online STEM course which is Chemistry during the outbreaks. This Chemist-tri will test the knowledge on chemistry science with the latest chemistry quiz questions and answers.

A modern, full-stack Learning Management System (LMS) by Vivelune, featuring SAT and AP Chemistry preparation, interactive lessons, personalized assignments, timed exams, automated grading, and student performance analytics.

Browser-based tools for Chemical Exchange Saturation Transfer (CEST) MRI analysis, including Bruker data import, WASSR-based B0 correction, Z-spectrum visualization, ROI analysis, and dynamic CEST imaging. Developed to enable rapid, accessible, and user-friendly MRI data processing directly on scanner computers.
